description: 500nits: challenge identified bulk crawlers on pages
expression: (http.host in {"500nits.com" "www.500nits.com" "doodletag.500nits.com" "task.500nits.com" "eddy.500nits.com"} and not (cf.client.bot and cf.verified_bot_category eq "Search Engine Crawler") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") and (ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".html") or not (http.request.uri.path contains ".")) and (lower(http.user_agent) contains "ahrefsbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "semrushbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mj12bot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "dotbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "gptbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "claudebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "ccbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "bytespider"))
